subject: reasoning
question:
Given below is a series of figures – A, B, C and D which follow a particular pattern. Which of the given option figures should come in place of E to continue the series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e04300b9fcffa2d94dfd23b98fd0134aed2d1377cea31db9311e121bc6bbc34a.png]
solution:
**The logic followed here is:**

Square shifts into the corners in clockwise and one new shape gets added around the square (which is added in left, top, right and bottom).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/376300013e137461150a3f5d0ee382430e34d9c5307fc6ce80636cefcf771c2d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
